<?php
$hot = $_POST["hot"];
$acceuil = $_POST["accueil"];
$res = $_POST["Restauration"];

$conn = mysqli_connect("localhost", "root", "");
mysqli_select_db($conn, "bd_bac_2018");

$date = date("Y-m-d");
echo $date;

$req1 = "SELECT * FROM evaluation WHERE DateEval='$date' AND Idhotel='$hot'";
$rep1 = mysqli_query($conn, $req1);

if (mysqli_num_rows($rep1) != 0) {
    echo "Cet hôtel a déjà été évalué";
} else {
    $date = date("Y-m-d");
    $somme = 0;
    $ex1 = $_POST["Extra1"];
    $ex2 = $_POST["Extra2"];
    $ex3 = $_POST["Extra3"];

    if (isset($ex1)) $somme +=1;
    if (isset($ex2)) $somme +=1;
    if (isset($ex3)) $somme +=1;

    echo $somme;

    $req2="insert into evaluation values ('$date','$hot','$acceuil','$res','$somme')";
    $rep2=mysqli_query($conn, $req2);
    echo "Évaluation enregistrée avec succès";
}

mysqli_close($conn);
?>
